title: Analysis: San Francisco-based AI startup insiders hold a combined $1.2T in equity; at Anthropic's IPO midpoint, the average employee's equity is valued at $72M (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Analysis: San Francisco-based AI startup insiders hold a combined $1.2T in equity; at Anthropic's IPO midpoint, the average employee's equity is valued at $72M — With Anthropic's IPO looming, a Businessweek analysis reveals a world-historical jackpot for insiders at city AI firms.
